messages:
Maria: Quick PSA — cutoff for v1.12.0 bumps is today EOD. If your PR needs a changelog one-liner, drop it here or add it to the changelog draft. :bell:
Cheng: thanks, pinging owners now. can folks confirm if their entries are consumer-facing or internal?
Ryan: mine is internal perf tweak (batching), will mark as [internal].
Sara: small docs tweak, consumer-facing. I'll paste a one-liner in a sec.
Alex: FYI I changed the bump number in package.json to 1.12.0-rc.1 in my branch — will we bump again on merge?
Maria: good q — we keep -rc on the branch, release process will strip to 1.12.0 on final artifact. no need to rewrite PRs now.
Sara: one-liner: "console: clarify error messages for missing API keys (helps debugging)"
Cheng: thanks. please follow the single-line template: `Component: short action and user-visible outcome`
Ryan: sample internal format I used: "Serving: batcher improves throughput for short sequences (internal)"
Maria: Also a reminder on tone: avoid implementation details, focus on user impact. Keep <80 chars if possible. :memo:
Alex: added my blurb: "Runtime: provisional bump for kernel selector to enable new quant flags" — is that too implementation-y?
Cheng: move "provisional" to PR body and change blurb to "Runtime: enable new quantization flags for lower memory usage"
Alex: updated.
release-bot: [automated] changelog-draft.md updated by Maria (link: https://git.redwood/changelog-draft/1.12.0)
Maria: Quick checklist before EOD:
- add one-liner to PR or paste here
- mark internal vs public
- ensure component prefix (SDK/Runtime/Serving/Console/etc)
- keep present-tense, user-focused
Cheng: can reviewers / release owners glance at changelog-draft before cutoff? I'll do a sweep at 17:30 PT.
Ryan: I can double-check SDK entries after 16:30 PT.
Sara: tagging @Alex for docs phrasing review.
Alex: ack. if anyone needs me to reword, paste it here and I'll edit.
Maria: tiny template you can copy:
```
Component: One-sentence user-facing change (keep short)
```
Maria: that's it — I'll merge the draft at cutoff unless there are objections. :+1:
Cheng: no objections from me.
Sara: good plan, thanks for keeping this tight.
Maria: thanks everyone — feel free to ping me directly if you're blocked.
